review_text: My favorite branch in the city so far. They have two floors and such exquisite architecture and interior design. It is spacious, a lot of seats and tables, perfect to chill in a busy day. I truly had a peaceful time with my drink here while working. Unfortunately, they don't have electrical outlet. Would love to come back here time to time. Overall, Great.

"I had a great time here, especially since it was my first visit. The place is spacious and well-designed, with a second floor that adds to the overall comfort and ambiance. They also offer free Wi-Fi, which is a nice bonus while you wait or relax. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was taken care of. What really stood out was the fast serving time—everything was efficient without compromising the quality of service. Overall, it was a very pleasant experience, and I would definitely recommend this place to others. Looking forward to coming back again!"

What I love: The overall aesthetic is fantastic, projecting a sense of class, sophistication, and positive energy. The design choices are well-executed. I especially appreciate the recent update where they now use sticker labels directly on the cup instead of writing on it—a much cleaner and professional look. The service is consistently quick and very efficient. Furthermore, this is a convenient drive-thru branch with ample parking spaces. The all-glass front and side are particularly pleasing and add a beautiful ambiance, especially at night. What needs improvement: My main concern is the spatial organization and capacity of this branch. I believe the original design did not fully anticipate how popular and easily crowded this location would become, which has been my consistent experience for years. On busy nights, such as paydays or special days, the indoor area can become excessively rowdy, hot, and loud. I strongly recommend reorganizing the ground floor seating. The current lounge chairs occupy too much valuable space, often hosting only one or two people and making it difficult for others to claim the remaining empty seats. Second Floor Heat: The absence of window blinds or adequate shading in the second-floor seating area causes excessive heat, particularly from noon through the late afternoon. I truly wish the management would consider a complete reorganization of the indoor space to better handle the consistent crowd volume.

I had a fantastic experience at Starbucks during my recent visit. The moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt inviting and calm. The space was filled with a gentle buzz of conversation, soft music, and the kind of cozy lighting that makes you want to stay longer than you planned. It was the perfect setting to relax, focus, or just take a break. I ordered two items, the four cheese flatbread and the bacon and sausage flatbread. Both were excellent. The four cheese option had a rich flavor that was perfectly balanced without being overwhelming, while the bacon and sausage one was hearty and satisfying. Together, they felt like the perfect mix of comfort food and café dining. Starbucks isn’t just about coffee. The food menu really holds its own, and these flatbreads are proof of that. The service was smooth from start to finish. The ordering process was quick, the staff were friendly, and everything came out warm and fresh. I never felt rushed, and yet everything moved along with great efficiency. The drinks, as always, were spot on. Starbucks has a way of making every sip feel consistent, whether it is a classic latte, a seasonal special, or a refreshing iced option. The balance between flavor and presentation is always reliable. What stood out most was how easy it was to simply enjoy being there. Starbucks has a way of creating a space that feels both professional and personal. You could go there to study, meet a friend, or just sit quietly with your own thoughts. If I could live in a coffee shop, this would be the one. Between the food, the drinks, the atmosphere, and the staff, Starbucks delivers a complete experience. Five out of five.

I don’t usually leave reviews about Starbucks, but what happened earlier really bothered me. My girlfriend went through the drive-thru and ordered a Pure Matcha Frappuccino. When she got to the payment window, the barista repeated her order—but said “Coffee Frappuccino” instead. She calmly corrected them and said it was Pure Matcha, not coffee. Now, we get it—mistakes happen. But what shocked us was how the barista making the drink reacted. She looked annoyed and started slamming the ingredients and tools around right in front of my girlfriend, clearly showing she was upset. It was uncomfortable and honestly very disrespectful. We’ve always liked Starbucks, but this experience at the Damosa branch really let us down. A little kindness and professionalism goes a long way—especially when the customer was just calmly correcting a mistake. Hoping the team here gets reminded about basic courtesy. We all have rough days, but it shouldn’t be taken out on customers. Plus you can always review the cctv footage.
